fact: The ANSADE regional head in Adrar says the fifth general population and housing census was carried out, for the first time entirely electronically from mapping and collection to processing and analysis; no enumeration date is given, so the document's published date is used.
ANSADE held a workshop in Atar on 3 August 2026 presenting the final results of the fifth general population and housing census for Adrar wilaya.
The document describes the fifth general population and housing census (RGPH) of 2023 as carried out under government supervision; no enumeration date beyond the year is given.
A regional workshop opened in Nouadhibou on 18 February 2026 to disseminate the definitive results of the fifth RGPH 2023, attended by ANSADE's deputy director general.
